methodology.comparison_rule: Compare each clean neutral facet against current pinned source; preserve native ownership; record MET, STRONGER, GAP, or CONTRADICTED; do not award a mapping from source presence.

facets.name: authorized_create
facets.evidence: clinical.observations.record plus Client view; typed vitals and pain additionally require clinical.observations.recordClinical.

facets.name: amend
facets.evidence: Correction columns and relationships exist, but no observation correction or amendment command was found.

facets.name: person_and_context_ownership
facets.evidence: Approved-Site Client scope, Shift-to-Client Site integrity, and protocol schedule owner, type, applicability, pending-state, and lock checks.

facets.name: measurements_and_atomicity
facets.evidence: Type-specific measurement data is range, enum, and time validated and atomically stored as embedded JSON; no separately owned child rows exist.

facets.name: request_to_persisted
facets.evidence: Validated request persists observation, timeline, and optional schedule effect in a three-attempt transaction; there is no preliminary state.

facets.name: register_filters
facets.evidence: Client, type, recorder, Site, and date are present; Shift, protocol or template, and top-level or child filters are absent.

facets.name: failure_and_provenance
facets.evidence: Invalid typed data, mismatched Shift, inaccessible or stale schedule deny before write; synchronous effects are transaction-bound; recorder, time, Site, timeline, and protocol provenance exist.

facets.name: request_replay
facets.evidence: Only pending protocol schedule completion is lock serialized; no ordinary request-key same-result replay exists.

facets.name: direct_object_concealment
facets.evidence: Foreign-Site attempts are explicit 403 rather than concealed 404.

results.native_preserve: Preserve ClinicalObservationService, embedded typed data, Client and Site ownership, protocol ownership, NEWS2, and timeline.
results.bounded_refinement: Add an append-only correction command with clinical.observations.correct, original-to-correction linkage, and the same Site, type, and context checks. Add only filters backed by native Shift, protocol, and hierarchy fields. Do not absorb questionnaires or approval and escalation.
negative_acceptance: Missing exact action denies with no row.
Vitals and pain deny without recordClinical.
Foreign-Site Client or filter writes nothing and leaks no row.
Mismatched Client and Shift or wrong, stale, or cross-Client schedule rolls back all effects.
Correction cannot mutate the original or cross Client, Site, or type.
Context and template filters cannot leak inaccessible rows.
results.reason: Amendment and required context, template, and hierarchy register facets are missing.

facets.name: authorized_create
facets.evidence: clinical.events.record plus Client view.

facets.name: general_and_type_authority
facets.evidence: One general record capability exists; event type changes validation but not action authority.

facets.name: person_and_visit_context
facets.evidence: Client is canonical owner; optional Shift must belong to that Client and match Site.

facets.name: amend
facets.evidence: No bounded event amendment or update command was found.

facets.name: related_inputs
facets.evidence: Witnesses and attachments are validated and Shift ownership is checked, but there is no general related-clinical owner and attachments persist after the core transaction.

facets.name: create_state
facets.evidence: Create writes an open event, timeline, and optional synchronous link in a three-attempt transaction; no preliminary state exists.

facets.name: invalidate_restore
facets.evidence: SoftDeletes exists on the model, but no separate invalidate or restore action was found.

facets.name: read_scope
facets.evidence: clinical.events.viewAny plus approved-Site record scope and Client, type, severity, Site, follow-up, review, and date filters.

facets.name: rollback
facets.evidence: Core validation and transaction rollback exist; attachment failure can occur after core commit and post-commit dispatch is not exactly once.

facets.name: provenance
facets.evidence: Site snapshot, AuditableChanges, reporter and time, and timeline provenance exist.

facets.name: replay_and_concealment
facets.evidence: No create replay or command row lock; foreign-Site direct action returns explicit 403 rather than concealed 404.

results.native_preserve: Preserve ClinicalEventService, Client and Shift Site integrity, typed validation, immediate-action requirement, timeline, and register.
results.bounded_refinement: Add separate append-only amend or supersede, reasoned invalidate, and restore actions with distinct capabilities. Make staged attachments part of an atomic or durable orchestration boundary. Do not fold review, follow-up, escalation, or incident closure into this target.
negative_acceptance: An event type requiring immediate action cannot write without truthful action.
Client, Shift, or Site mismatch writes nothing.
Invalid attachment cannot silently claim an all-or-nothing event package.
Amend cannot overwrite reporter or original provenance or cross Client or Site.
Invalidation and restore require distinct actions and a reason.
results.reason: Amendment, type authority, invalidate and restore, and full related-item atomicity are missing.

facets.name: action_authority
facets.evidence: Review and close require incidents.approve and state predicates; review reauthorizes the locked row.

facets.name: accessible_concealed_object
facets.evidence: viewAny is unconditional on Site; review checks action plus state but not approved Site. Close asserts Site but returns 403, not concealed 404.

facets.name: neutral_state_chain
facets.evidence: Native states are draft, submitted, reviewed, and closed. Investigation, root cause, and improvement actions remain canonical H&S owners outside this target.

facets.name: closure_prerequisites
facets.evidence: Review evidence and no open follow-ups are direct gates; high-severity investigation and linked governance closure are external owner gates.

facets.name: actor_time_audit_concurrency
facets.evidence: Actor and time fields, AuditableChanges, parent row locks, shared lock ordering, and durable lifecycle outbox exist.

facets.name: invalid_state_and_process_conflict
facets.evidence: Policy, validation, and blocker errors are explicit; inconsistent journey ownership is concealed 404.

facets.name: replay_and_delivery
facets.evidence: Repeat review or close rejects state rather than returning original result; notification dispatch after commit is not exactly once.

results.native_preserve: Preserve IncidentJourney closure gates, parent locking, actor and time audit, durable lifecycle outbox, and canonical H&S ownership.
results.bounded_refinement: Resolve show, review, and close through approved-Site scope with an explicit all-Sites bypass and indistinguishable 404, repeated under lock. If a lifecycle projection is needed, expose read-only prerequisite evidence from canonical owners rather than transplanting H&S workflow.
negative_acceptance: Actor with incidents.approve but no target-Site access receives indistinguishable 404 with no mutation, audit, or notification.
Only submitted incidents review and only reviewed incidents close.
Missing review, follow-up, investigation, or action prerequisite blocks close.
Concurrent follow-up creation and close cannot leave a closed incident with open work.
Audit or outbox failure rolls back state.
Repeated close cannot duplicate signals or effects.
results.reason: The access and concealment contradiction is material, and required investigation, cause, and action ownership is deliberately outside the target.
